healthyDefinition: PASS only when every required gate passes. Deep Dive coverage, market freshness, expert ingestion, specialty screening and final snapshots are independently verified.

deepDiveEvidence.detail: All 16 games have matchup classifications plus a six-way matrix base; late official practice/inactive overlays must continue to supersede stale assumptions.

marketCoverage.detail: Full Week 1 market snapshot exists; game-day prices still require live refresh for execution.

upsetLab.detail: Week 1 +250/+300 screening exists, but current prices must be rechecked as markets move.

expertEpisodeInventory.detail: Canonical data/nfl-expert-weekly.json remains an older generated snapshot while later governed episode/audit records exist; lossless ledger synchronization remains unresolved.

canonicalGameJoins.detail: New NFL expert records are required to join canonical nfl-weekly-board IDs; unmatched records remain hard ingestion failures.

practiceAvailabilityFreshness.detail: The Wednesday checkpoint explicitly lacked later official practice reports for Sunday/Monday games. These overlays must be current before final execution.

finalPreKickoffSnapshots.detail: Every remaining unplayed game requires an immutable 60–90 minute pre-kickoff snapshot after current market and official inactive checks.

currentPriorityQueue: Losslessly synchronize later governed NFL expert records into data/nfl-expert-weekly.json
Overlay current official practice/injury reports on every unplayed game
Refresh current market and key-number sensitivity
Re-run NFL Upset Lab at current prices
Freeze final snapshots for every remaining kickoff
Keep six-way matchup matrices current with personnel changes
notificationPolicy: Notify only for material handicap evidence, price/model/status changes, official activations, meaningful Upset Lab changes, or unresolved gate failures.
